data.body_html:
Choosing between the Astondoa 40, Azimut 39 and Pershing 46 for your Marbella charter? Each boat offers a distinct experience, from relaxed cruising to high-speed thrills. This three-way comparison breaks down specs, capacity, price and best use cases — so you can pick the right vessel for your day on the Costa del Sol.

Specs at a glance

BoatLengthMax paxPrice (2h)Price (8h)
Astondoa 4012.5m9€749€2,299
Azimut 3912.5m11€749€2,299
Pershing 4614m10On requestOn request

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance and VAT. The Pershing 46 is priced on request — contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

Astondoa 40: balanced cruiser for small groups

The Astondoa 40 is a 12.5m motor yacht with a capacity of 9 passengers. It's the most affordable option in this comparison, with fixed rates from €749 for 2 hours. Perfect for families or small groups who want a comfortable, stable ride along the Marbella coastline. The Astondoa 40 is available for charter from Puerto Banús and includes all standard inclusions.

Azimut 39: more space, same price

The Azimut 39 matches the Astondoa 40 in length (12.5m) but carries up to 11 passengers — two more. It's priced identically: €749/2h or €2,299/8h. If you're organising a group of 10 or 11, the Azimut 39 gives you extra berths without extra cost. Its layout is ideal for socialising, with a spacious cockpit and sun pads.

Pershing 46: sporty performance

The Pershing 46 is a 14m sports yacht that reaches speeds around 45 knots — significantly faster than the other two. It accommodates 10 passengers and is priced on request. Choose the Pershing if you want adrenaline, wave-hopping and a more exclusive feel. It also departs from Puerto Banús and includes all standard inclusions.

Capacity comparison: who fits where?

  • Astondoa 40: up to 9 pax — best for small families or couples
  • Azimut 39: up to 11 pax — best for medium groups or parties
  • Pershing 46: up to 10 pax — best for friends wanting speed

If your group is 9 or fewer, the Astondoa 40 is the most cost-effective. For 10–11, the Azimut 39 is the only option with fixed pricing. The Pershing 46 suits 10 pax but at a premium.

Price and value

The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are priced identically: €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Both represent excellent value for a fully inclusive charter with skipper, fuel, drinks and snacks. The Pershing 46 is priced on request — expect a premium for its sportier performance. Contact us via WhatsApp for a quote.

Which one should you book?

Choose the Astondoa 40 if you want a simple, affordable day out for up to 9 people. Choose the Azimut 39 if you have 10–11 guests and want the same price. Choose the Pershing 46 if speed and style matter more than budget. All three are excellent boats for exploring Marbella, Puerto Banús and the Costa del Sol.
